mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 7.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic contraction in both residential construction and manufacturing, depressing corporate earnings and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing regime (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%), accommodative policy supports equity valuations through lower discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates weakening labor market conditions that reduce household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 600,000 units signals severe residential construction contraction that reduces economic activity and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) indicates recessionary conditions where monetary policy fails to offset labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and UNRATE > 7.0%, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO declining > 2% monthly), industrial output contraction reduces corporate production capacity and profitability, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO decline > 2% monthly, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
